root_cause: Call IDs authenticate output-only continuations, not the entire contents of a self-contained replay. The reuse probe ignored new system/schema instructions in scoring and could similarly undo replaced history. Routing and execution both use this probe.
changes: Restrict call-ID-only reuse to requests that actually require live tool state; self-contained replays use visible/text/token prefix checks.
Skill returns restore checkpoints only if the caller's original rendered prefix still matches. A rewritten caller history is replayed and the obsolete checkpoint is consumed after successful sync.
Preserve output-only continuation and visible-prefix reuse; apply the same rule to the equivalent Anthropic branch.
Propagate automatic compaction failures with their cause instead of sending the original oversized request.
Disarm the threshold policy only after a successful replacement, allowing a later user retry after failure.
Update the bundled library wheel and lockfile.
